subject.title: fix: stabilize embedded prompt caching across policy and Responses boundaries

question: Should denied turns retain model-visible schemas for computer, cron, gateway, and nodes to preserve prompt-cache shape, with immutable authorization enforced immediately before hooks and execution?
rationale: Code review can verify the enforcement mechanics, but it cannot decide whether schema visibility itself is an acceptable permanent security and product contract.

options.title: Accept visible schemas
options.body: Keep the stable catalogue and execution-time denial, then require exact-head live cache and denial proof before merge.

options.title: Preserve hidden schemas
options.body: Retain schema omission for denied turns and redesign cache stability without exposing unavailable protected tools.

recommendation.title: Accept visible schemas
recommendation.body: Keep the stable catalogue and execution-time denial, then require exact-head live cache and denial proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans the agent, MCP, and Codex ownership boundaries involved in this decision.
